annotations.title: How collateral and borrowers are graded

description: How ASPERN grades what secures a vault’s lending, and how far that grading reaches today. What is graded (each collateral token on price, exit (a liquidity/volume proxy, not an executable quote), oracle and contract; each lending market’s borrowers on bad debt and debt near liquidation; a vault through the share of its lending in each grade), the inputs and their sources, the grade bands with their thresholds, the rule by which more than 10% of a vault’s collateral lending in a weak grade raises its risk band, the scenario model (falls, sale impact, factors that fall together; scenarios, not probabilities) and what it cannot see. `coverage` counts the collateral tokens and markets graded, by grade, and the open vaults that lend against collateral, with read times; nothing is named. Free.
